Support cybersecurity initiatives by evaluating technologies against RMF, Continuous ATO, Zero Trust, STIG, and vulnerability management requirements. IAT Level II certification equivalent or higher (CompTIA Security+ CE, CISSP, CySA, etc.) in accordance with DoD 8570/8140 requirements.
